summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for senior unsecured autocallable contingent coupon barrier notes due October 14, 2030, linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100 Index, Russell 2000 Index and VanEck Semiconductor ETF. Issue price is $1,000 per note with a monthly contingent coupon of $11.46 and monthly call observation beginning April 2027. Aggregate principal is blank, with pricing dated October 9, 2026 and settlement October 15, 2026. This is a routine structured medium-term note takedown, not a special situation; watch index performance versus coupon and threshold barriers.
